title: From Constitutions to Control: Interpretable Rewards for Aligning Language Models
reasoning: The paper deals with operationalizing constitutions (including the 'Claude Constitution' which discusses ethics) to align language models, allowing for targeted behavioral adjustments like balancing helpfulness vs. harmfulness, and mitigating label biases like sycophancy and demographic bias. This covers values, principles, and ethics (as parts of the constitution) and thus counts as ethics/morals related.
